text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ――Alright, Trainer, let's start with warm-ups!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was a faculty sports meet, and I ended up participating in soccer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I mentioned, "I need to practice to get my body used to it,"
Narita Top Road eagerly said, "I'll teach you!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
Next up is jogging!
Warming up your body helps prevent injuries, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this!
Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Traaaaceeeen!
Fight! Oh!
Fight! Oh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm looking forward to it!
With your tactical sense, Trainer, I'm sure you'll read the battlefield perfectly and do great!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Break through the enemy's defense...!
And shoot, wham! ...Like that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Are you okay!?
Did I push the pace way too fast right out of the gate...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
I thought I had put together
a routine with just the right workload, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um... I just thought that maybe...
you could do it, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was a little surprised.
It seems she thinks quite highly of me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is the burden Narita Top Road has always carried...
When I think about that—
choice_data_list: (I want to... properly live up to her expectations too.)
(I want to... live up to her expectations properly, too.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
Um, shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Still, pushing yourself so hard is...
choice_data_list: I want to try my best like you, too.
I want to try my best like you do

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Like... me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the serious, intense training began!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Sprint! Run, run! Stop, and pass!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Here I come! I'm taking that ball!
Now, try and get away from me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I worked hard until the sun went down that day.
I might not have exercised this much since I was a student...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
10 more reps! Focus, focus!
You can definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now, the day of the sports festival!
Under a crisp, clear sky,
she cheered me on before the match.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, do your best!
The sweat and tears you shed will never betray you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The match began.
Running all over the field, I was gasping for air.
However, when I glanced over at the stands...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! Hooray! Trai-ner!
Score that goal~! Oh!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And we're in the final phase... Whoa!
The teachers' team seized an opening and scored!
That makes it 2-2 with barely any time remaining...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"That defense just now was so close!
Ugh, Team Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Steals the ball! Dribbling into enemy territory!
Can they take it all the way?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...! Trainer!
Go for it! Do your beeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Running with everything I had,
I could hear Narita Top Road cheering loudly.
I want to answer it...! Those expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Win—!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Game oveeeer!
Decided with a magnificent shot!
The Trainer Team wins!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh! That was the absolute best!
What a nail-biter of a match!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slipping away from the post-event party with the faculty,
I came to eat ramen
with Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It was truly, truly incredible! Right at the very end, like BAM! Trainer, you were just...!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to practicing with you.
It's all thanks to practicing with you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...! Ehehe!
I'm so glad I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She rejoiced with boundless excitement.
Seeing her so happy brought me supreme joy as well.
choice_data_list: Did I manage to live up to your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Expectations...? Ah...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"When you said 'like me,' Trainer,
is this what you meant?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu...! I see...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You've shown me something that far exceeded my expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Youth, you say?
Now that you mention it, we really did feel like clubmates!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "If Trainer were a student, I wonder if every day would feel like that...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Lending each other textbooks... competing for regular spots on the team... On graduation day, I feel like I might just cry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That makes me feel, somehow...
Ehehe, I can't put it into words well,
but my heart is fluttering a little!
